name: elspeths_smite_survivor_dying_later_this_turn_is_exiled
notes: Printed: '... deals 3 damage to target ATTACKING or blocking creature. If that creature would die THIS TURN, exile it instead.' Seat 0's 5/5 attacks and seat 1's 2/2 blocks. After blocks seat 0 casts Elspeth's Smite on its own ATTACKING 5/5: it survives the 3 damage, then takes 2 combat damage from the blocker and dies the same turn: it is exiled. The 2/2 blocker, never targeted, dies to the 5/5's damage and goes to the graveyard.
